dedupe_keys.name: bcr onec el salvador 2024 population and housing census dwelling indicators table electricity source water supply piped water sanitation grey water cooking fuel wall roof and floor materials structures by department municipality and district arcgis feature service

description: The statistics office of El Salvador's central bank publishes results of the 2024 Population and Housing Census on an ArcGIS Hub geoportal, and the dashboards read from public ArcGIS feature services. The master table behind the dwelling dashboard holds counts and shares for each category of each dwelling indicator by department, municipality and district: the source of electricity, the water supplier, whether piped water reaches the dwelling, the type of sanitation and grey water disposal, refuse disposal, cooking fuel, wall, roof and floor materials, and occupied and vacant dwellings. At national level it lists 1,640,857 dwellings on the public electricity service, 6,408 using solar panels and 42,292 without electricity, and 801,985 supplied by the national water utility ANDA against 504,709 on community systems. Companion layers give private dwellings and ICT indicators per district with boundaries. Format and access: ArcGIS REST queries return JSON or GeoJSON without a key. Licence: not stated. Caveats: the service is named as a test table and the Estructuras category counts look implausible, so check totals against published reports; the 2024 municipal reform means districts are the former municipalities. Simulation uses: district level electricity and water access, roof materials for storm exposure, and sanitation for wastewater planning. Related records: the 2007 census REDATAM database from the same office.

Indicators: Electricidad (public service, solar panels, wind, fuel generator, neighbour connection, other, none), Suministro (ANDA utility, community system, private company, private or public well, public tap, neighbour, water body, tanker, rainwater), Chorro (piped inside dwelling, in yard only, none), Servicio Sanitario (sewer, septic tank, biodigester, latrine, none), Uso Sanitario, Aguas Grises, Residuos, Combustible, Material Paredes, Techo, Piso, Vivienda ocupada and desocupada, Estructuras.
